cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get our lost hour back before lunch. Put yesterday's missing hour in this jar.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take the lid off. You pour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold the jar. You tell me when the whole hour's in and I'll close it.

reason: Replace labeling excuse with negotiated physical help that leaves B responsible for the impossible time-filling judgment; keep purpose and deadline spoken.
